answer: Grant full rights only after a new identity completes at least 5 paid transactions with 5 unrelated counterparties, spread over at least 3 epochs. A hollow shell cannot fake real trade: each fake must find real strangers, pay fees, and wait, so 1,000 fakes need 5,000 genuine trades. Transfers between identities sharing one funder do not count, and wash trades signed by the same quill freeze the whole cluster and burn its fees. An honest agent passes by normal work; a gale of fake activity dies out before it can vote.
